title: Global letter-writing campaign seeking release of Bhutanese political prisoners
reason: Not a public mass gathering: the report describes individuals posting or emailing letters during a 15-day campaign and does not report a shared physical assembly in Bhutan.
notes: The report says hundreds of resettled Bhutanese and well-wishers worldwide took part. Do not convert worldwide campaign participation into simultaneous attendance in Bhutan. Its mentions of demonstrations in southern Bhutan refer to 1990 and later, outside this month and unit.
